findings: Red-mud cure: specimens were sealed with film for the first 24 h → sealed set to true.
Lithium-slag batch basis relies on the paper's misnumbered 'Table 3' sentence → recorded as an inferred reading in gaps.
Null activator amounts listed as 'basis not given': display text only; the 184 g NaOH per 1000 g silicate preparation stays in the material detail. No change.
All 54 air-cooled slag labels match precursor, water/binder, modulus and SS dose.
Carbonated N- cure quote omitted the 35-day sealed storage → quote extended to the full sentence sequence.
Hydroxide molarity 10 refers to the NaOH stock mixed into the GP-liquor, which is the meaning of this parameter in every sheet. No change; the stock wording is in the quote.
Foam cure omits the 28-day room storage before heating: already a gap; test age left null. No change.
GP-liquor/filler by mass recorded as liquid/solid: same quantity. No change.

lessons: Review-note 'no label' skips are often fully labelled in the paper: 5/5 papers gave mix IDs, 2/5 gave complete batch ledgers with numeric results.
Papers reporting results only in figures yield designs without numbers; figure reading stays out of scope.
Source contradictions (row counts, ratio labels, table numbering) were kept in gaps, never repaired.
